title: Ledger monetary truth is atomic and double-entry
summary: A banking economic event is visible only when its complete journal, authority provenance and durable receipt commit atomically. Same-currency transactions sum to zero; FX balances independently per currency. A business reversal is a new event, not repair for a failed atomic commit.
invariants: Transaction header, every posting leg, decision provenance and durable receipt commit in one SERIALIZABLE transaction or none become visible.
For each committed same-currency transaction, sum of posting minor units is zero.
For FX, the zero-sum invariant is applied independently to each currency; unlike currencies are never summed together.
A hold is not a posting: hold state/event/provenance/receipt commit atomically while the reservation itself creates zero Ledger postings.
Internal settlement/fee/FX accounts are Ledger-owned infrastructure; channels do not nominate arbitrary internal GL accounts.

provenance.claim: Ledger owns monetary truth and durable receipts.
Balanced journal, atomic commit and hold invariants.
